description: Decoded event logs for any contract and event on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, Polygon or BNB Chain: give the event as a human signature (e.g. "Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value)"), optional indexed-topic filters, and get the newest matching logs with named, ABI-decoded arguments (exact integers as strings, checksummed addresses). Scans backwards from the head with an adaptive block window. Keyless public RPC. Price: $0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/evm-logs

address.description: Contract address emitting the event (0x, 20 bytes)

blocks.description: Max blocks to scan back from toBlock

chain.description: eth (default), base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon or bsc (chain ids and common aliases accepted)

event.description: Event signature, e.g. "Swap(address indexed sender, uint256 amount0In, ...)". Mark indexed params; without "indexed" the first N params are assumed indexed from the topic count

topic1.description: Filter on the 1st indexed param: address, uint (decimal) or 32-byte hex

name: evm_logs
title: Evm Logs
